title: SRD: only a player character has Heroic Inspiration; engine: a monster can be granted it and is then offered rerolls

history.reason: tests/srd/test_glossary.py::test_heroic_inspiration_a_monster_cant_gain_it ends with `assert r.dice == [3] and not r.hit`, where r comes from `C.attack(...)`. That returns an AttackResult (dungdra/combat.py:938) with fields roll, hit, crit, damage, target and notes, and no `dice`. The d20 dice are at `r.roll.dice`, which is how the other attack tests in the same file read them (test_glossary.py:2474 and :2485). With the engine fix, every rule assertion in this test passes: the grant is refused cleanly with page 183 and ruling R-50, the ogre's heroic_inspiration stays False, and no reroll is offered. Only this attribute access raises an AttributeError. Proposed correction, for a person to approve: change the line to `assert r.roll.dice == [3] and not r.hit`. That keeps the assertion's intent: the forced 3 stands and the attack misses.

history.summary: rechecked the change already in the working tree
